title: Tax post-success semantic checks use the current ownership pin to read changed historical rows

locations.meaning: The normal api.request completes its ledger reconciliation before semantic verification.

impact: After a legitimate Tax correction commits and the generic ledger advances current owned SHA/xmin, semantic verification would reject the original basis before it verifies the business invariants. Results and superseded old operating snapshots have the same mismatch. This is a helper correctness issue; the FS reproduction is not an executed Tax correction or a backend failure.

minimalRepairBoundary.changeScope: A dedicated attempt-bound historical reader used only by verifyTax13Semantics for old owned rows.
requiredBridge: Require a complete actual 201 attempt, matching operation/request identity, and an immutable ownership-complete ledger without blockers.
Read and hash-check attempt.before/after pins, and deep-compare their parsed immutable snapshots with the supplied before/after objects. loadSnapshot objects have no manifest property.
Require the same database/table/PK to exist once in both snapshots, an undeleted genuinely HTTP-owned birth, and the current latest SHA/xmin to equal the after row.
For changed rows require latestProof.kind HTTP-owned-row-update, this exact requestId/operationId, beforeSha256 equal to the old row, and exact beforeSnapshot/afterSnapshot pins.
Do not reset current latest ownership to a historical row. Do not edit producer source labels, original ledgers, original Stage receipts or 195/220/221/223 artifacts.
requiredIndependentNegatives: Wrong before/after pins or snapshot contents
Global and after readers remain strict

publication: Root reported that 119 has not been published. Hold publication until the small successor is separately reviewed and a new explicit H1/plain-array/plan revision is sealed; preserve the old promotion and inspect evidence.

limits.claim: Support diagnosis and a verifiable regression input, not an independent product G3 certificate.
